representation_source: Municipal charter and delegated traffic-management ordinance
legal_power: Activate a temporary six-month traffic-calming trial on named municipal streets
jurisdiction_territorial: Example City; Oak Street and Pine Avenue segments listed in protected annex
jurisdiction_personal: Road users and municipal operators within the trial area
jurisdiction_subject_matter: Temporary traffic routing and street design
public_summary: Activates a six-month, reversible municipal traffic-calming trial with emergency access, disability access, midpoint review, and automatic deactivation.
data_purpose: Operate, monitor, review, and close the authorized traffic trial
retention_rule: Public decision record retained; personal contact data deleted 90 days after closure unless a claim remains open
human_accountable_officer: Director of Transport Operations, Example City
prohibited_inferences: This activation does not authorize policing, detention, surveillance, benefit withdrawal, or application outside the listed streets and dates.
Technical deployment does not amend the municipal ordinance or renew the trial.

payload.rollback: Return street configuration within 48 hours after stop order or expiry
